extra-5c4aa0df9875.en: High-quality anime footage. High-density 3D toon / cel-look, high-speed sword clash of a near-future academy-city-style cinematic action RPG. Theatrical-film-class key animation, high-quality compositing, translucent lighting, dense background art. @1 is calm and overwhelmingly superior; @2 is a challenger who takes on the fight with speed and number of strikes. Attacks, parries, counterattacks from reaction force, and the maximum collision are connected without a break. [Reference images and character locking] Read the @1 reference image and the **@2 reference image as two different people. Use the reference images only to maintain the face, eye shape, iris color, hairstyle, hair color, costume, ornaments, physique, silhouette, atmosphere, character color, and existing weapon design. Do not reproduce the background, room, furniture, text, split layout, pose, composition, angle of view, or framing of the reference images. The two are throughout the entire piece each the same single person, same person, same character identity. Only the expression, gaze, mouth, posture, breathing, and natural sway of hair and costume may change. Averaging of faces, mixing of features, hair color swapping, costume swapping, weapon swapping, becoming different people, cloning, doppelgangers, and addition of extra people are forbidden. Extract each person's main color, secondary color, accent color, material feel, decorative motif, and worldview from the reference images, and thereafter use them as @1's inherent color and @2's inherent color**. Do not exchange colors between the two. The background, props, glowing guide lines, floor reflections, air, steam, lighting, and effects are redesigned to harmonize with the two characters' costumes, ornaments, personalities, and worldview while maintaining the fixed stage structure. However, the flow of the battle, positional relationships, contact points, and camera order are not changed. [Art style locking] Thin, delicate colored outlines. Clear two- to three-stage cel shading and translucent midtone shadows on faces, hair, costumes, and equipment. Use the inherent colors of the reference images in clear, high saturation, with multi-layer highlights on eyes and hair. High density down to faces, hair strands, embroidery, ornaments, metal, jewels, and weapon fittings. Render cloth, leather, metal, jewels, wet floor, and glass with different reflections and roughness. Use each character's inherent color for key light and shadow color, and keep the background one step darker than the characters. Do not use thick black outlines, flat single-layer cel shadows, simplified TV anime, generic 3D beautiful-girl faces, maturation, smooth plastic CG, semi-realism, realism, low-density backgrounds, dull colors, or mixed art styles. [Stage and atmosphere] A near-future academy city after rain, a wet rooftop training ground at dusk. Glowing guide lines, colored reflections on the floor, high-rise school buildings, glass walls, city skyline, thin steam. No one other than the two. Architectural ornaments, floor patterns, railings, lighting fixtures, training equipment, and abstract patterns of distant advertisements are matched to the reference characters' motifs, but no text, logos, or UI are shown. [Camera] Rather than a fixed side view, use in order: a low three-quarter view skimming the floor following @2, an oblique front chest-up of @1, an over-the-shoulder of @1, an approximately 60-degree orbit around the contact point as the axis, and an oblique low-altitude camera closing in on the final collision. The camera and background rotate; do not rotate the characters meaninglessly. [Weapon locking] The two each hold only one sword, two in total. If the reference images have weapons, maintain their shape, length, ornamentation, and color scheme; if they are not swords, redesign them as a single sword inheriting that design. In all cuts, fix the number, blade, guard, grip, scabbard, and tassel connections. Hands grip only the handle behind the guard. Move the blade, guard, and grip as one integrated weapon from the shoulders, elbows, hips, and support legs; do not rotate only the blade or tip. @1 holds the grip near the waist with the right hand only at the moment of the parry, and uses the left index finger. @2 holds the sword with both hands. [Motion] Cut 1: Start from the instant the **@1 inherent-color horizontal slash light from the end of the immediately preceding clip crosses in front of the lens. The light is a curved afterglow adhering to the sweep plane of the sword, not an independent laser. When the light passes, the camera connects to a low three-quarter position skimming the floor behind @2's left. @2 kicks the wet floor with the left foot and delivers a diagonal downward slash from upper right to lower left with the two-handed sword toward @1's right shoulder. Water droplets, hair, and cloth trail behind in the direction opposite to the acceleration. The @2 inherent-color** sword light covers the lens and becomes an occluding wipe to the next close-range cut. Cut 2: When @2's sword light passes, **show @1 chest-up from an oblique front. @1 does not retreat a single step and is expressionless. Holding the sword low with the right hand, @1 forms a single thin hexagonal defensive surface of @1's inherent color in front of the left index finger. @2's slash hits a single contact point at the center of the defensive surface, and the local flash, hexagonal ripples, and @2's inherent-color sparks synchronize. When @1 flicks the finger and wrist a few centimeters outward, the entire defensive surface tilts, and @2's trajectory is deflected about 45 degrees upward from outside @1's shoulder. A reverse reaction force returns to @2**'s arms, shoulders, and hips, and the support leg steps again. The camera follows the diverted trajectory with a whip pan. Cut 3: At the end of the whip pan, **enter over @1's shoulder. @2 uses the returned reaction force, pivots the hips once around the left foot as the axis, and delivers a low return slash. @1 returns the left hand to the grip, receives the two blades at a single point at their mid-blades, and immediately after a short hit stop slides the contact surface to flick @2's sword up and outward. Without pause, @1 steps into close range and returns an upward slash of @1's inherent color from lower left to upper right. The camera orbits about 60 degrees around the contact point, and the railing and floor reflections move greatly. @2 is pushed diagonally backward, half-rotates in the air, lands on the right foot, and slides briefly. @1 advances without stopping. Only @2 is pushed back**, an asymmetric movement. The splash from the landing covers the lower part of the screen. Cut 4: Beyond the splash, an oblique low-altitude composition placing @1 large in the left foreground and @2 in the right background. Do not line the two up side by side. @2 steps the right foot again at the end of the slide and, without stopping, delivers a **@2 inherent-color downward swing from upper right to center. @1 also does not stop advancing and delivers an @1 inherent-color upward slash from lower left to center. From the feet and behind each of the two, a huge flame-like aura of their respective inherent colors erupts upward, accompanied by glowing cracks in the floor, thin lightning, and updrafts. The two colors do not mix. Let the shapes of the two swords be readable only for the instant they enter the same contact point, and hide them behind the glow after contact. With the same contact point as the source, @1's straight trajectory and @2's curved trajectory form a giant X shape. Only the narrow incandescent center is pure white, and the two inherent colors remain outside it. Maintain large-area high-saturation color fields, and from the same collision core spread radial shockwaves, concentric pressure waves, vertical flame-like auras, volumetric light, lightning, and sparks. Floor water, steam, dust, debris, hair, and costumes are blown outward, and the colored effects occupy most of the screen. @1's pressure collapses @2's defensive posture.** The camera briefly rushes toward the contact point, is pushed back slightly by the shockwave, and tilts a few degrees. Do not whiten the entire screen. [Major NG] Fixed side-view fighting-game perspective, left-right symmetric full-body composition, resetting by separating the two to the left and right edges, simultaneous flipping, mirrored simultaneous dashes, long run-ups, long blade locks, meaningless continuous spinning, independent lasers, third light rays, two-color fusion, full-screen whiteout, text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI, no sound generation. [Ending] @1's energy pushes the contact point **toward @2's side, and the water spray and dust on @2's side swell backward. @2's silhouette begins to collapse diagonally backward, and @1** continues to drive force forward with a low center of gravity. The giant two-color X-shaped light expands to its maximum, and at the instant of contact when the characters and blades are hidden by the light, cut immediately on that frame capturing the beginning of the collapse. Action continues.

extra-7a61a7fc721d.zh-Hans:
0–3秒 — 钩子
一位年轻女巫僵立在黑暗森林中，一只巨大怪物朝她冲来。
女巫：“十秒……我只需要十秒！”

3–8秒 — 咒语
她举起发光法杖，快速念诵魔法咒语。怪物越来越近。

8–12秒 — 倒计时
怪物：“你太迟了！”
女巫念出最后一个词：“TRANSFORMUS！”

12–16秒 — 魔法爆发
巨大的紫色光芒爆炸充满屏幕。一切陷入寂静。

16–21秒 — 反转
烟雾散去。怪物一脸困惑。
女巫不见了……取而代之的是一只穿着她袍子的微小可爱鸭子。

21–26秒 — 反应
鸭子低头看自己，愤怒地嘎嘎叫，用翅膀拍打法杖。

26–30秒 — 笑点
怪物慢慢后退。
怪物：“……说实话，我怕她。”
鸭子突然开始追他。
音效：嘎！嘎！嘎！
结尾文字：
✨ 永远不要催促咒语。🦆

extra-520681fb996e.zh-Hans:
使用上传图像作为角色、服装、构图、照明和整体电影感外观的精确视觉参考。创作一段照片级写实真人视频，

一位年轻女子穿着长款完全闭合的象牙白定制大衣、黑色太阳镜和黑色尖头高跟鞋，缓慢而自信地径直走向庞大人群。她的姿态优雅克制，双臂自然垂于身侧，表情严肃平静。

以中远景正面镜头开始。女子径直朝镜头和人群中央走去。镜头以相同速度平滑向后跟拍，使她完美保持在中央。人群完全静止，向前注视。

她到达人群正前方中央位置并完全停下。双脚自然落定，双臂垂于身侧，肩膀放松。她透过黑色太阳镜直视镜头。

女子保持100%完全静止。

然后，就在她正后方，整个人群突然开始以完美同步的节奏移动。

他们的动作应尖锐且令人不安：

头部快速猛转向一侧

肩膀猛然上耸

上半身短暂前倾

they suddenly snap upright again

像完美同步的群体一样一起重复该动作

动作发生在整个人群中，从最近的人到最深处的后排。

女子完全不做任何动作。
无头部动作。
无身体动作。
无手部动作。
无行走。
无反应。

她只是静止站立，而她身后的所有人以同步方式激烈移动。

镜头缓慢向女子推进，同时人群在她身后继续同步动作。保持她的脸和白色大衣清晰对焦，而移动的人群具有微妙的电影感景深模糊。

以有力的居中近景/中景结束。女子在前景完全静止，而人群在她身后完成最后一次同步的头部与肩膀猛动。

在最后时刻保持她静止的表情。

视觉方向

黑暗、冷峻、高端电影时尚美学。原始混凝土环境，深阴影，柔和顶光，真实皮肤与织物，自然头发物理，真实人体运动。

The central visual contrast is extremely important:
ONE perfectly still woman in white + a large crowd in black moving violently in perfect synchronization behind her.

无重复主角。
无额外白色服装。
无男性。
无卡通或动画。
无CGI外观。
无夸张镜头晃动。
无文字。
无字幕。
无标志。
无突然场景变化。
无额外角色出现或消失。
